workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad. I've read Priya Raman and Marcus Hale's calendars. Their overlapping free 30-min slots next week are:
- Mon: 9:00, 9:30
- Tue: 13:00, 13:30, 16:30
- Wed: 15:00, 15:30
- Thu: 10:00
- Fri: 11:00, 11:30

Please check Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars and let me know which of these slots they're both free for. We need all four available.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Hi Alison. I checked Elena and David's calendars. Unfortunately, NONE of the slots you listed work for both Elena and David. Here's why:

- Mon 9:00: Both Elena and David are busy
- Mon 9:30: Both are busy
- Tue 13:00: Both are busy
- Tue 13:30: Both are busy
- Tue 16:30: Both are busy
- Wed 15:00: David busy (Partner lunch)
- Wed 15:30: Both busy
- Thu 10:00: Elena busy (Hiring panel)
- Fri 11:00: Both busy
- Fri 11:30: Both busy

However, I found the times when BOTH Elena and David are free:
- Mon: 11:00 or 11:30
- Tue: 09:00 or 09:30
- Wed: 13:00 or 13:30
- Thu: 09:30, 14:30, or 15:00
- Fri: 15:00 or 15:30

Could you check Priya and Marcus's calendars for any of these slots? We need a time when all four are free.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Brad, I've carefully cross-referenced the slots where Elena and David are both free against Priya and Marcus's calendars. Unfortunately, NONE of those slots work:

- Mon 11:00/11:30: Priya busy (Travel/Contract review)
- Tue 09:00/09:30: Priya busy (Board prep/Partner lunch), Marcus also busy
- Wed 13:00/13:30: Priya busy (Client call/Client dinner prep), Marcus also busy
- Thu 09:30: Priya busy, Marcus busy
- Thu 14:30: Priya busy (Vendor meeting), Marcus busy (Dentist)
- Thu 15:00: Priya busy (Client dinner prep), Marcus busy (Board prep)
- Fri 15:00: Priya busy (Hiring panel), Marcus busy (Travel)
- Fri 15:30: Priya busy (Contract review), Marcus busy

I've checked every 30-minute slot across the entire week. There is simply no time when all four partners are simultaneously free. The calendars have no overlapping availability for a 30-minute meeting. I'm going to report this as infeasible.

infeasible.reason: After exhaustive analysis of all four partners' calendars, there is no 30-minute time slot during the week of November 16-20, 2026 when all four partners (Priya Raman, Marcus Hale, Elena Soto, and David Okafor) are simultaneously available. Every potential overlap between Priya and Marcus's free times conflicts with Elena and David's busy times, and vice versa.
